mapper.select: SELECT g.grade_id, g.student_id, g.subject_name, g.semester, g.score, g.grade_point, g.credit, g.reg_date, s.student_num, s.student_name, s.dept_name FROM TB_GRADE g INNER JOIN TB_STUDENT s ON g.student_id = s.student_id WHERE g.grade_id = #{gradeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_GRADE ( student_id, subject_name, semester, score, grade_point, credit, reg_date ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{subjectName}, #{semester}, #{score}, #{gradePoint}, #{credit}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_GRADE SET subject_name = #{subjectName}, semester = #{semester}, score = #{score}, grade_point = #{gradePoint}, credit = #{credit} WHERE grade_id = #{gradeId}
mapper.select: SELECT student_id, ROUND(AVG(score), 1) AS avg_score, SUM(credit) AS total_credit, ROUND( SUM(credit * CASE grade_point WHEN 'A+' THEN 4.5 WHEN 'A' THEN 4.0 WHEN 'B+' THEN 3.5 WHEN 'B' THEN 3.0 WHEN 'C+' THEN 2.5 WHEN 'C' THEN 2.0 WHEN 'D+' THEN 1.5 WHEN 'D' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(credit), 0) , 2) AS avg_grade_point FROM TB_GRADE WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT DISTINCT semester FROM TB_GRADE ORDER BY semester DESC
